name: Linden Owen
life: “I still remember a holiday paycheck held up by one empty signature box.” People around the approach to Seabright Court know Linden by a small Saturday habit. Linden likes to watch the beach traffic thin enough for workers going the other way.
voice: I need the papers to renew my job. I'm willing to wait longer than either side thinks.
appearance: Linden is easy to recognize by a high puff tied with plain cord and a straight nose and deep-set eyes. Usually dressed in a cream pullover with a thin silver ring worn on a cord, Linden folds a paper napkin into quarters without noticing when listening.
personality: Linden is kind in very practical ways and prickly about being thanked in public. Linden loves being recognized by the people who notice what happens after the guests have left.
agenda: To renew work without rushing the decision.
family: Omar Blake is Linden’s second cousin. Linden checks the date twice. Omar brings something that can still be enjoyed tomorrow. Arrangements do change in their family. Taking a delay seriously without treating it as an insult took both of them years. Asked about *First shift back*, Omar says, “I want a private room to make a call home. My coworkers keep generously offering to listen.”
connections: Lina Carbone. The worker waiting for renewal learns that the last call was ordinary and probably precious.

reactions.situation: A relative wants the absent signer's address
reactions.response: Linden asks the absent person what address, if any, can be shared.

reactions.situation: A coworker arrives late after a night at the hospital
reactions.response: Linden takes one immediate task off their hands and asks when they want to tell the supervisor.
